newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: Lyons Irish Holdings reports H1 pretax up 7.5pct.
newsitem.headline: Lyons Irish Holdings reports H1 pretax up 7.5pct.

text.p: Lyons Irish Holdings on Friday reported a 7.5 percent increase in pretax profits in the 26 weeks to February 15, 1997, of 4.36 million Irish pounds.

The company said the board was recommending that interim dividend be increased by 0.8 pence per share to 8.6 pence. It described the results as "very satisfactory". "This is a very significant achievement at a time when inflation was less than 1.0 percent. Lyons tea sales in Northern Ireland continue to increase but....it will be some time before this translates into significant profit," it said.
It described its full-year outlook as very positive.
Turnover was 14.02 million pounds against 13.29 in the year-ago period and 27.14 in the year to August 17, 1996.
The company said that to keep in line with the accounting timetable of the majority shareholder, Unilever plc it planned to change its year-end to December.
A second interim dividend will be paid in December 1997, after the issue of a 12-month interim report, it said.
